clue.text: One to get money from measure in case of necessity

parts.note: one is A, the indefinite article
to tap someone is to get money out of them
an inch is a measure of length

explanation.surface: Someone extracting cash from a measured quantity when things get desperate.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means if absolutely necessary, as a last resort in an emergency.

clue.text: Some following last character that's clownish

indicators.note: following means the second piece comes after the first in the answer

parts.note: Z is the last character of the alphabet
some means any, as in 'have you any?'

explanation.surface: Part of the closing letter of something is being described as comical.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a zany act is wildly comic, like a clown's.

clue.text: A woman left out programme for meeting

indicators.note: out means the letter for left is dropped from the woman's name

parts.note: Glenda is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman leaves out a programme item meant for a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an agenda is the list of items to be discussed at a meeting.

clue.text: Abandon joint set to be cooked

indicators.note: cooked means altered or tampered with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Giving up on a joint of meat that was set aside for cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to jettison something is to throw it away or discard it.

clue.text: Question rises possibly about family having peculiar quality

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters are placed around the family word
possibly signals that the letters of rises may be arranged another way

parts.note: kin means family

explanation.surface: A question arises about a family that has an odd character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rises possibly' reads as a verb phrase, but 'possibly' is the anagram signal and 'about' the container; IRESS splits around the family word. 'having' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: quirkiness is oddness, the quality of having peculiar habits.

clue.text: Goddess at that time embraced by a European

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside the following letters

parts.note: then means at that time

explanation.surface: A goddess of old held in the arms of a European.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is the Greek goddess of wisdom, also spelt Athena.

clue.text: Conventional and revolutionary paintings, say, in spectacle

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a sight is a spectacle

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: paintings are an example of art

explanation.surface: An art show that is both traditional and radical makes quite a spectacle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like it describes the paintings as radical; it is the reversal signal, giving TRA. 'and' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: straight can mean conventional or orthodox in behaviour.

clue.text: Hundred turning up to worry islander

parts.note: a ton is a hundred

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the word reads bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: to nag is to worry or pester

explanation.surface: Someone frets over a hundred of something that keeps cropping up.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tongan is a native of Tonga, an island kingdom in the Pacific.

clue.text: Union left in case of emergency

indicators.note: in means the departing word sits inside the outer letters
case of means the outer letters, the casing, of the next word

parts.note: quit means left, departed

explanation.surface: A union walked out when an emergency struck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case of emergency' gives its outer letters E and Y, which hold QUIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Equity is the British actors' trade union.

clue.text: Nimble agent set about run

indicators.note: set about means placed around the next letter

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A nimble secret agent sets off on a run.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: spry means active and lively, especially of an older person.

clue.text: Ranter's not composed, one without chance of success

indicators.note: composed means put together, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A ranter who has lost his cool will get nowhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a person or plan with no hope of succeeding is said never to get going.

clue.text: Obscure meaning with note put out in mystery

indicators.note: obscure, as a verb, means to disguise, so the letters are jumbled
put out means a letter is removed from the word

explanation.surface: Hidden meaning, with a note expelled, adds to a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obscure' looks like an adjective but is the anagram signal; 'put out' removes an N from MEANING, leaving MEAING to be rearranged. 'with' and 'in' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an enigma is a mystery or riddle.

clue.text: Sum of money supplied by foreign character and lord for relative

parts.note: a grand is a thousand pounds or dollars
chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: An heir receives a large sum from a foreign aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's child is a family relative two generations down.

clue.text: Gold adds piquancy to patronage

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
to spice something is to add piquancy to it

explanation.surface: Rich sponsorship livens up the proceedings.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: under the auspices of means with the patronage or backing of.

clue.text: Transport needed when one's late?

parts.note: late here means dead, not behind time, so this is the vehicle that carries a coffin

explanation.definitionFit: Funeral vehicle: it conveys the deceased to burial or cremation.

clue.text: Ominous woman of devotion around home

indicators.note: around means the first word is placed about the second

parts.note: a sister is a nun, a woman devoted to religion
in means at home

explanation.surface: A nun gathered round the house gives off a threatening air.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sinister means threatening or suggestive of evil.

clue.text: Girl facing river and extension to building

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England

explanation.surface: A girl looks out at a river from a new wing of the house.
explanation.definitionFit: An annexe is a building or wing added on to a main one.

clue.text: The plane flying is a Jumbo

indicators.note: flying suggests the letters are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: The aircraft in the air is a jumbo jet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumbo' looks like the jet; it was the famous London Zoo animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Jumbo was a celebrated circus beast, and the name is used for any big tusked pachyderm.

clue.text: Way shown by second elder, say, with time

parts.note: an elder is an example of a tree

explanation.surface: A path is pointed out by a second senior person, given time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elder' suggests an older person; here it is the shrub. 'shown by' and 'with' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a street is a road or way, and it appears in many street names.

clue.text: House in confines of wood, one in literary thriller

indicators.note: in means the house abbreviation goes inside the outer letters
confines of means the boundary letters, first and last, of the word

parts.note: a unit is one

explanation.surface: A house deep in the woods is the setting for a mystery novel.
explanation.definitionFit: A detective novel built around discovering the killer is commonly so called.

clue.text: Wait for sycophantic follower after departure of Queen

indicators.note: after departure of means the following letters are removed

parts.note: a hanger-on is a fawning follower
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is a crossword abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: A hanger-on waits for the Queen to leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to ask someone to pause or hold briefly is to tell them to wait.

clue.text: Elizabeth receiving request for container

indicators.note: receiving means the name takes the next word inside it

parts.note: Bet is a short form of Elizabeth
ask means request

explanation.surface: Elizabeth gets a request for a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A basket is a woven container.

clue.text: By the sound of it, support in the past

indicators.note: by the sound of it signals that a phrase spoken gives the answer

parts.note: to be for something is to support it

explanation.surface: Apparently backing was given at some earlier time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'support' gives BE FOR, which sounds the same as the single word meaning earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: before means previously, at an earlier time.

clue.text: No longer useful like an old reference book?

definitions.text: No longer useful like an old reference book?

parts.words: No longer useful like an old reference book?
parts.note: an outdated book is left sitting unused in the bookcase, the idiom for something set aside as no longer wanted

explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: something put aside is no longer wanted or used, literally stored away.

clue.text: Hotel found in largely early part of London

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the shortened word
largely means most of the word, its last letter dropped

parts.note: soon means early
H is Hotel in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: A hotel stands in a mostly old district of London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'largely' cuts SOON to SOO, which holds H.
explanation.definitionFit: Soho is a district of the West End of London.

clue.text: Bar established among friends, a venture

indicators.note: established among means the letters sit inside the run of words

explanation.surface: A bar set up among friends is a risky undertaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: save as a preposition means except, as bar does.

clue.text: Dog that is at rear of Scottish island

indicators.note: at rear of means the second piece goes behind the first

parts.note: Coll is an island of the Inner Hebrides
IE, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A dog is found at the back of a Scottish island.
explanation.definitionFit: A collie is a breed of Scottish sheepdog.

clue.text: Growing obsession about heads of royalty in view

indicators.note: about means the obsession word goes around the initials

parts.note: a thing can mean an obsession, as in having a thing about

indicators.note: heads of means the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A growing fixation on royalty is out in the open.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: thriving means flourishing, growing well.
